body:
# Duelist's Glove

A Curios glove for **dual-wield sword combat** on NeoForge. Alternate attacks between your main and off hand with **vanilla swing animations** — each hit plays from the hand you strike with.

---

## Features

- Equips in the Curios **gloves** slot
- With a **sword in each hand**, attacks alternate automatically (powered by [Open Hands Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-hands-lib))
- **Separate cooldown per hand** — main hand and off hand each have their own attack timer. After you strike with one hand, the other can still be ready; hits only land at **full charge** for that hand, same as vanilla
- **Vanilla attack animations** — no custom swing poses; the correct hand animates each hit
- **Glove durability** `3122` (2× a diamond sword), −1 per successful dual-sword hit
- **+30% sword attack cooldown** on both hands while dual-sword mode is active — a small trade-off for fighting with two blades

---

## Dependencies

| Loader | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.1 |
| [Open Hands Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-hands-lib) | 0.1.1+ (`open_hands_lib`) |
| **NeoForge** | 21.1.219+, Kotlin for Forge 5.9.0+, [Curios](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios) 9.5.1+ |
| **Fabric** | Fabric Loader 0.16.14+, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, [Trinkets](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets) 3.10.0+, Cardinal Components API 6.1.0+ |

---

## How to use

1. Craft the **Duelist's Glove**
2. Open your Curios menu and equip it in the **Gloves** slot
3. Hold a **sword in your main hand** and a **sword in your off hand**
4. Attack as usual — hits will alternate between hands

When the glove breaks, dual-sword mode stops until you equip a new one.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- **Loader:** NeoForge
- **Side:** Client & Server
